title: Variance bounded by total stable influence
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $k$ be a natural number. If every subset with nonzero Fourier coefficient has size at most $k$, and $0\le\rho\le1$, then $\rho^{\max(k-1,0)}\operatorname{Var}(f)\le\sum_{i=1}^n\sum_{S\ni i}\rho^{|S|-1}\widehat f(S)^2$, where the inner sum ranges over subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ containing $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
the Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$
